title: Context Wallet: purpose-bound, user-reviewed context packets from a local profile
description:
Context Wallet is an offline prototype for sharing only the personal context a task needs. From a local profile, a person chooses specific allowlisted fields, names a recipient, states a purpose and sets a short lifetime (up to seven days), then sees the exact JSON before export. Export requires explicit confirmation, writes exactly the previewed bytes and never overwrites a file. A verify command checks schema and expiry, and a consume command records use in a local ledger so the same packet is not consumed twice from that ledger.

Scope: packets are plaintext and unsigned; recipient and purpose are descriptive labels, and expiry is advisory and enforced only by this program. There is no network client or integration with any service. The sample profile is fictional.

Usage: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only; pip install . adds a context-wallet command. Start with python3 context_wallet.py preview --profile sample-data/profile.json ... as shown in the README. Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (run in CI on Python 3.10 to 3.13 with coverage).

Citation: cite the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23061441 for all versions, or the version DOI of the release you used. Source code: github.com/sparkainlp-x/context-wallet. Licence: AGPL-3.0-only; commercial licensing is available (see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).
